content: विघट् €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To be disunited or separated. .²2 To be spoiled or ruined. .²3 To be stopped, break down. .²4 To assume various shapes; उपरि विघटमानः प्रौढतापिच्छनीलः <ls>Māl. 9. 24</ls>; <ls>Mv. 5. 42</ls>. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To separate, disperse, tear apart; विघटयन्त्यग्रे नभोऽभोमुचः <ls>Māl. 5. 2</ls>. .²2 To remove, displace. .²3 To mar, frustrate.
